@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Drowsy driving is as dangerous as drunk driving. If you experience f______e, you should stop to rest.
= fatigue
~詞義 fatigue（n.）疲勞
~原文 Drowsy driving is as dangerous as drunk driving. If you experience fatigue, you should stop to rest.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The i______s people make up almost three percent of Taiwan's population, and they can be divided into sixteen different tribes.
= indigenous
~詞義 indigenous（adj.）原住民族的;當地的
~原文 The indigenous people make up almost three percent of Taiwan's population, and they can be divided into sixteen different tribes.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: To prove her argument, the speaker c______ed government reports and studies published by scholars.
= cited
~詞義 cite（v.）引用
~原文 To prove her argument, the speaker cited government reports and studies published by scholars.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The couple are not afraid of displaying their a______n for each other in public; they often hold hands or even kiss each other on the cheeks.
= affection
~詞義 affection（n.）喜愛
~原文 The couple are not afraid of displaying their affection for each other in public; they often hold hands or even kiss each other on the cheeks.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jim asked his students some questions to make sure they c______ded what had been taught.
= comprehended
~詞義 comprehend（v.）理解
~原文 Jim asked his students some questions to make sure they comprehended what had been taught.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: People prepare a diamond ring when proposing marriage as it is a symbol of ______ love.
A: beneficial
B: communist
C: eternal
D: hostile
= C
~詞義 eternal（adj.）永恆的
~原文 People prepare a diamond ring when proposing marriage as it is a symbol of eternal love.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Our car is really old, and its ______ costs us a lot of money; maybe it's time for us to buy a new one.
A: comprehension
B: curriculum
C: interference
D: maintenance
= D
~詞義 maintenance（n.）維修;維護
~原文 Our car is really old, and its maintenance costs us a lot of money; maybe it's time for us to buy a new one.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Ted ______ his classmate Anne into sharing homework answers, even though she felt uncomfortable doing so.
A: bullied
B: convicted
C: embraced
D: excluded
= A
~詞義 bully（v.）脅迫
~原文 Ted bullied his classmate Anne into sharing homework answers, even though she felt uncomfortable doing so.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The school library offers ______ resources, including books, journals, and an online database.
A: abundant
B: agricultural
C: compassionate
D: cautious
= A
~詞義 abundant（adj.）豐富的
~原文 The school library offers abundant resources, including books, journals, and an online database.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The doctor ______ against eating too much sugar, especially for people with higher health risks.
A: compromised
B: fascinated
C: entitled
D: cautioned
= D
~詞義 caution（v.）告誡;提醒
~原文 The doctor cautioned against eating too much sugar, especially for people with higher health risks.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: accessible
B: bid
C: cuisine
D: carbon
E: exclusive
F: journalist

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ prepared a lot of questions for the interview, but the government official answered only a few of them.
= F
~詞義 journalist（n.）記者
~原文 The journalist prepared a lot of questions for the interview, but the government official answered only a few of them.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The organization decided to make a(n) ______ of $4 million for the large piece of land.
= B
~詞義 bid（n.）競標
~原文 The organization decided to make a(n) bid of $4 million for the large piece of land.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Among all types of traditional Taiwanese ______, stinky tofu is my favorite.
= C
~詞義 cuisine（n.）佳餚
~原文 Among all types of traditional Taiwanese cuisine, stinky tofu is my favorite.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The villagers widened the road to make their village more ______. They hope that more tourists will come to visit in the future.
= A
~詞義 accessible（adj.）可到達的
~原文 The villagers widened the road to make their village more accessible. They hope that more tourists will come to visit in the future.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company has ______ rights to import this brand's products. They are the only company that can sell these products in the country.
= E
~詞義 exclusive（adj.）獨有的
~原文 The company has exclusive rights to import this brand's products. They are the only company that can sell these products in the country.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: adolescent
B: compromise
C: compassion
D: dialect
E: convict
F: hostile

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The boy showed great ______ for the lonely old lady; he sat and chatted with her for a long time.
= C
~詞義 compassion（n.）同情
~原文 The boy showed great compassion for the lonely old lady; he sat and chatted with her for a long time.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Elephants are usually very gentle animals; however, a mother elephant may become ______ toward anyone who goes near her baby.
= F
~詞義 hostile（adj.）有敵意的
~原文 Elephants are usually very gentle animals; however, a mother elephant may become hostile toward anyone who goes near her baby.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ignoring traffic signals can ______ the safety of both drivers and pedestrians.
= B
~詞義 compromise（v.）危害
~原文 Ignoring traffic signals can compromise the safety of both drivers and pedestrians.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Parents may become upset with their ______ kids because teenagers can sometimes be stubborn and emotional.
= A
~詞義 adolescent（adj.）青春期的
~原文 Parents may become upset with their adolescent kids because teenagers can sometimes be stubborn and emotional.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The two men come from the same region and speak a(n) ______ which few people understand.
= D
~詞義 dialect（n.）方言
~原文 The two men come from the same region and speak a(n) dialect which few people understand.
